ModMetaData.name: RimDefDump (local tooling)
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Local research tooling, not gameplay content.
Dumps the RimWorld def database to JSON at game load, AFTER all mods have loaded and all PatchOperations have applied. This is the post-resolution ground truth that an offline Defs/ scan cannot see: patch results, mod-vs-mod override winners, true shortHashes, and resolved stat values.
Adds no defs, no Harmony patches, and no gameplay behaviour. It only reads the def database and writes files.
INERT BY DEFAULT. It does nothing at all unless a request marker file exists at: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Ludeon Studios\RimWorld by Ludeon Studios\DefDump\dump_request.txt
Marker contents select the scope: (empty) or "animals" - animals.json + manifest.json (fast, seconds) "all" - the above plus defs/<DefType>.json for every def type with a database (slow, large)
Companion to Utils/animal_inventory.py, which is the offline authoring view. This is the live verification view.
